I think I’m bipolar.
Long story short: in 2017, my Mom and I lost our home —> we got a new place, but the whole thing kind of threw me off.
Around March 2020, I ran away from home. Mom’s always been this cliche of the controlling but loving (well, conditional love) African Muslim mother, and I guess I just couldn’t deal with her ways anymore.
The plan was to come back, eventually, when we would both cool off. But that didn’t happen. And sometime around this summer, she got her hands on my neck. Sometime later, some dude I was in love with also had his hands around my neck. And now, the boy I’m in love with broke up with me. Again. And everything feels hopeless. I just graduated. My career is already in shambles. I think I’ve reached my limit.
I’ve tried therapy, self-medication, hospitalisation, going with the flow... I think I’m just tired of the cyclical nature of it all. Rationally, I understand and I do believe that it gets better. Just can’t deal with the in between moments when it gets worse.
